lastCompletedStory.title: Add suggestion fingerprint, follow-up builder, and dedup helpers

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a PURE module src/supervisor/suggestion-followups.ts with 4 exports: fingerprintFinding(finding) -> 12-hex-char sha256 prefix (Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256'), fields normalized-and-joined with '::' delimiter so missing file/line never collides with a distinct text); buildFollowUpIssue(finding, { source, round? }) -> { title, description } where title is the finding text truncated at 80 chars (ellipsis '…'), and description is finding.text + blank line + 'Source: <source>' + optional 'Review round: <n>' + optional 'Location: <file>[:<line>]' + blank line + 'suggestion-fingerprint: <hash>'; extractSuggestions(report) filters findings to severity==='SUGGESTION'; dedupSuggestions(backlog, report) scans open (status==='open') IssueEntry.description strings for a 'suggestion-fingerprint: <hex>' line via regex, builds a Set of already-filed fingerprints, then walks extractSuggestions(report) skipping any finding whose fingerprintFinding() is in that set OR already seen earlier in the same batch. All 4 are exported with types FollowUpProvenance and FollowUpIssue. US-003 (next, priority 3) wires this into runSidecarLoop: per its notes, add optional readReviewReportFn/fileSuggestionsFn/notify deps to RunSidecarLoopOptions (loop.ts:1517), wire production deps in buildSidecarLoopDeps (sidecar.ts:2141-2196) using makeReadReviewReport(cwd) from host.ts:134, createLocalIssueOnMain (issue-file.ts:271), readBacklogFromMain (issues/backlog.ts), and these US-002 helpers; place the hook in runSidecarLoop next to the CAM-191/ADR-0013 auto-ship block (loop.ts:1882-1911), strictly AFTER opts.clearActive() and before the flipActiveFn continue, gated on result.status in ('complete','awaiting-operator') AND re-read prd.review.lastVerdict in TERMINAL_VERDICTS (decide.ts:66). For provenance when calling buildFollowUpIssue from that hook: pass source = prd.branchName (no 'cycle id' concept exists in the codebase today, confirmed by grep), round = prd.review.roundsCompleted. Gotcha caught during this story: writing '\u0000' (raw NUL) into a JSON-tool-authored TS source file produces an actual raw NUL byte in the file (the `file` command then reports it as 'data', not text, and grep silently no-ops without -a) -- use a plain ASCII delimiter like '::' instead of NUL for any future field-join-then-hash helper, never a NUL escape typed into a Write/Edit content string.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed constructor new Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256'), sha256 explicitly supported, update(input) accepts a string, and digest('hex') returns a hex string (not Uint8Array) when an encoding is passed. Matches the implementation and the PRD-level officialDocsConsulted entry; no deprecations noted.
